mapper.select: SELECT user_id FROM t_user WHERE username=#{username} AND status='active'
SELECT memory_id, memory_type, content, source, create_time FROM ai_user_memory WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND content_hash=#{contentHash}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_user_memory (user_id, memory_type, content, content_hash, source) VALUES (#{userId}, #{memoryType}, #{content}, #{contentHash}, #{source})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM ai_user_memory WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND memory_id=#{memoryId}
